meta.source: The Tongue and Quill (AFH 33-337), sample adverbs table
meta.notes: Transcribed on 2026-09-18 from an image of the handbook's "Sample Adverbs" table, not from the handbook itself, because e-Publishing refuses automated requests; so it stays marked stub until someone reads it against the page. Shown on the Verbs page with widths, as a companion to the action verb list. None of these is a vague intensifier, so none is flagged by Fluff Patrol, but an adverb still rarely does the work a number does.
